title: Microstructural Evolution and Fatigue Performance of Welded Joints in Thick-Wall Pressure Vessels
authors: Yan Long Ding, Jin Qiang Zhao, Xin Hui Wang, Heng Li, Ming Ming Zhang, Xin Guang Du
abstract: Thick-wall welded pressure vessels operate under combinations of internal pressure, thermal cycling, structural restraint, corrosive or hydrogen-containing environments, and long service durations. In such components, fatigue performance is not governed by a single nominal material property but by a manufacturing-dependent internal state comprising spatially variable microstructure, hardness, local constitutive response, and residual stress. This review critically synthesizes the mechanisms by which welding processes and post-weld heat treatment determine fatigue performance in thick-wall pressure-vessel joints, with emphasis on SA508-type reactor pressure-vessel steels and 2.25Cr-1Mo- 0.25V/Cr-Mo-V steels used in petrochemical and hydrogenation reactors. Conventional multi-pass arc welding, narrow-gap welding, electron-beam welding, and laser-based high-energy-density processes are interpreted as distinct thermal-history generators. Their associated peak temperatures, cooling rates, reheating cycles, and through-thickness thermal gradients control fusion-zone solidification, HAZ subdivision, prior-austenite grain evolution, martensite-austenite constituent formation, carbide/carbonitride precipitation, segregation, and local mechanical mismatch. The review further evaluates how welding residual stresses originate from thermal contraction, plasticity, phase-transformation strain, restraint, and wall-thickness effects, and how post-weld heat treatment redistributes stress while simultaneously modifying phase stability and precipitate morphology. Fatigue crack initiation and propagation are discussed as coupled microstructure-residual-stress phenomena involving cyclic strain localization, small-crack interaction with microstructural barriers, crack-tip constraint, and environmental acceleration. Advanced characterization methods, including EBSD, SEM/TEM/APT, neutron diffraction, nanoindentation, and small punch testing, are assessed as enabling tools for spatially resolved microstructure-property mapping. Finally, thermometallurgical- mechanical simulation, crystal plasticity, representative-volume-element modelling, fracture mechanics, physics-informed machine learning, and digital-twin frameworks are synthesized into a process-microstructure-stress-fatigue roadmap for predictive integrity management. The central conclusion is that fatigue assessment of thick-wall welded pressure vessels must transition from averaged weld-region properties toward history-dependent, spatially resolved, and experimentally validated frameworks capable of linking fabrication parameters directly to fatigue life.
venue: International Journal of Computational Materials Science and Engineering

zh-Hans.title: 厚壁压力容器焊接接头的微观组织演变与疲劳性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 厚壁焊接压力容器在内压、热循环、结构约束、腐蚀性或含氢环境以及长期服役等因素的共同作用下运行。在此类构件中，疲劳性能并非由单一的名义材料性能决定，而是受制造过程相关的内部状态支配，该状态包括随空间位置变化的微观组织、硬度、局部本构响应和残余应力。本综述以批判性视角综合分析了焊接工艺和焊后热处理决定厚壁压力容器接头疲劳性能的机制，重点关注SA508型反应堆压力容器钢，以及石化和加氢反应器中使用的2.25Cr-1Mo-0.25V/Cr-Mo-V钢。常规多道电弧焊、窄间隙焊、电子束焊和激光高能量密度焊接工艺被视为产生不同热历程的方式。其对应的峰值温度、冷却速率、再热循环和沿壁厚方向的温度梯度控制着熔合区凝固、热影响区（HAZ）分区、原奥氏体晶粒演变、马氏体-奥氏体组元形成、碳化物/碳氮化物析出、偏析以及局部力学失配。本综述进一步评估了热收缩、塑性变形、相变应变、约束和壁厚效应如何产生焊接残余应力，以及焊后热处理如何在改变相稳定性和析出物形貌的同时使应力重新分布。疲劳裂纹萌生与扩展被作为微观组织与残余应力耦合现象加以讨论，涉及循环应变局部化、小裂纹与微观组织障碍的相互作用、裂纹尖端约束以及环境加速作用。综述评估了EBSD、SEM/TEM/APT、中子衍射、纳米压痕和小冲杆试验等先进表征方法，探讨其作为实现空间分辨微观组织-性能映射的工具的作用。最后，将热-冶金-力学模拟、晶体塑性、代表性体积单元建模、断裂力学、物理信息机器学习和数字孪生框架整合为面向预测性完整性管理的工艺-微观组织-应力-疲劳路线图。核心结论是，厚壁焊接压力容器的疲劳评估必须从采用焊接区域平均性能，转向依赖历程、具备空间分辨能力且经过实验验证的框架，以便将制造参数与疲劳寿命直接关联起来。

title: Non-Destructive Evaluation for Engineered Surfaces: Methods, In-Process Sensing, and Data-Driven Inspection in the NDE 4.0 Era
authors: Kuldeep Sharma, R. P. Sharma
abstract: Engineered surfaces such as coatings, diffusion layers, cold-sprayed deposits, laser-clad overlays, additively manufactured surface regions, peened layers, and anodised films increasingly determine the performance, inspect ability, and service life of high-value metallic and ceramic components. Wear, corrosion, fatigue, oxidation, debonding, and crack initiation are controlled in these shallow, graded, anisotropic, and interface- dominated regions. This review examines how non-destructive evaluation (NDE) methods can be selected and qualified for them. It links inspection physics to specific problems: coating thickness and adhesion, near- surface residual stress, porosity gradients, lack of fusion, thermal-barrier-coating debonding, weak cold-spray interfaces, and additive-manufacturing surface roughness. Magnetic Barkhausen noise, eddy-current testing, active infrared thermography, phased-array and laser ultrasonics, acoustic emission, optical metrology, digital image correlation, microwave and terahertz sensing, and X-ray computed tomography are assessed for both capability and limitation. The review argues for hierarchical, multi-modal strategies in which rapid screening is followed by calibrated confirmation where required. It also covers the shift toward NDE 4.0, including in- process sensing, data fusion, physics-informed machine learning, uncertainty-aware interpretation, and digital twins. Persistent barriers include limited probability-of-detection evidence, poor transferability of data-driven models, scarce reference specimens, and incomplete acceptance criteria
venue: South Mediterranean University Journal of Pure and Applied Sciences

infographic.engineering_relevance: Combining rapid screening with calibrated confirmation can support inspection of coatings, cold-sprayed deposits, laser-clad overlays, and additively manufactured surface regions.

Match electromagnetic, thermal, ultrasonic, optical, and X-ray methods to inspection needs.

zh-Hans.title: 工程化表面的无损评价：NDE 4.0 时代的方法、过程在线传感与数据驱动检测
zh-Hans.abstract: 涂层、扩散层、冷喷涂沉积层、激光熔覆层、增材制造表面区域、喷丸强化层和阳极氧化膜等工程化表面，日益决定着高价值金属与陶瓷部件的性能、可检测性和服役寿命。磨损、腐蚀、疲劳、氧化、脱粘和裂纹萌生受这些浅薄、梯度变化、各向异性且由界面主导的区域控制。本综述探讨如何为这些区域选择无损评价（NDE）方法并确认其适用性，将检测物理原理与具体问题联系起来，包括涂层厚度与附着力、近表面残余应力、孔隙率梯度、未熔合、热障涂层脱粘、冷喷涂界面结合薄弱以及增材制造表面粗糙度。综述评估了磁巴克豪森噪声、涡流检测、主动红外热成像、相控阵与激光超声、声发射、光学计量、数字图像相关、微波与太赫兹传感以及 X 射线计算机断层成像的能力与局限性。综述主张采用分层、多模态策略，先进行快速筛查，再在必要时采用经校准的方法进行确认。综述还涵盖了向 NDE 4.0 的转型，包括过程在线传感、数据融合、物理信息机器学习、考虑不确定性的结果解读以及数字孪生。持续存在的障碍包括检出概率证据有限、数据驱动模型的可迁移性较差、参考试样稀缺以及验收准则不完善。

infographic.key_insight: 对工程化表面进行可靠评价，需要采用分层、多模态无损评价，使检测物理原理与表面及界面缺陷相匹配。

将电磁、热学、超声、光学及 X 射线方法与检测需求相匹配。

title: Solution Precursor Plasma Spraying: Are We Missing a Trick by Dismissing It?
authors: Shrikant Vishwanath Joshi
abstract: Abstract Solution Precursor Plasma Spraying (SPPS), wherein dissolved metal salt precursors are injected into a plasma jet to synthesize diverse functional coatings, offers compelling advantages over conventional thermal spray techniques. These include elimination of powder synthesis, use of aqueous precursor feedstock capable of achieving molecular-level compositional control, and rapid one-step synthesis of coatings with chemistries for which spray-grade powders are readily unavailable, such as high-entropy oxides, perovskites, and related complex oxides. Despite these strengths and an encouraging body of prior research, SPPS research has declined from its modest peak in the mid-2010s. This is attributable primarily to the prohibitively narrow processing windows and low deposition rates imposed by legacy thermal spray hardware. This perspective argues that the advent of high-power axially-fed plasma spray systems fundamentally changes the technological landscape for SPPS. Axial injection delivers symmetric, near-complete thermal energy utilization, broader process windows, and deposition rates of practical interest in early demonstrations, thereby addressing the above limitations at laboratory scale. Emerging axial SPPS results across diverse material systems already demonstrate coating microstructures and performance metrics that rival suspension plasma spray, validating the broader promise of this approach. Although challenges related to precursor handling, feedstock delivery, and economics yet need to be tackled, SPPS with modern axial feed capable plasma torches represents a strategic opportunity that now merits systematic industrially oriented evaluation.

infographic.key_insight: Modern high-power, axially fed plasma torches could revive solution precursor plasma spraying (SPPS) by overcoming the narrow processing windows and low deposition rates associated with legacy hardware.
infographic.engineering_relevance: SPPS enables direct coating synthesis from dissolved metal salts, avoiding powder production while offering molecular-level composition control for complex oxides.

zh-Hans.title: 溶液前驱体等离子喷涂：我们是否因轻视它而错失良机？
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 溶液前驱体等离子喷涂（SPPS）通过将溶解的金属盐前驱体注入等离子射流来合成多种功能涂层，与传统热喷涂技术相比具有显著优势。这些优势包括省去粉末合成步骤、使用能够实现分子级成分控制的水性前驱体原料，以及通过快速一步法合成高熵氧化物、钙钛矿及相关复杂氧化物等难以获取喷涂级粉末的材料涂层。尽管具有这些优势，且已有一批令人鼓舞的研究成果，SPPS研究仍在2010年代中期达到一个不算高的峰值后有所减少。这主要归因于传统热喷涂设备所造成的极为狭窄的工艺窗口和较低的沉积速率。本文认为，高功率轴向进料等离子喷涂系统的出现从根本上改变了SPPS的技术格局。在早期演示中，轴向注入实现了对称且近乎完全的热能利用、更宽的工艺窗口，以及具有实际应用价值的沉积速率，从而在实验室尺度上克服了上述局限。不同材料体系中不断涌现的轴向进料SPPS研究结果已显示，其涂层微观结构和性能指标可与悬浮液等离子喷涂相媲美，印证了这一方法更广泛的应用潜力。尽管前驱体处理、原料输送和经济性方面的挑战仍有待解决，采用具备轴向进料能力的现代等离子喷枪开展SPPS仍代表着一个战略性机遇，如今值得对其开展系统的、面向工业应用的评估。

infographic.key_insight: 现代高功率轴向进料等离子喷枪有望克服传统设备工艺窗口狭窄和沉积速率低的局限，从而推动溶液前驱体等离子喷涂（SPPS）重新发展。
infographic.engineering_relevance: SPPS可直接由溶解的金属盐合成涂层，省去粉末制备环节，同时为复杂氧化物提供分子级成分控制。
method: 将溶解的金属盐前驱体注入等离子射流以合成涂层。
采用高功率轴向注入，提高热能利用率并拓宽工艺窗口。
评估不同材料体系中不断涌现的轴向进料SPPS研究结果。
infographic.evidence_signal: 本文援引了早期实验室演示结果，表明其沉积速率具有实际应用价值，涂层微观结构和性能可与悬浮液等离子喷涂相媲美，但摘要未提供定量基准。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining 3D welding simulations with neural networks identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports process-window selection to reduce weld defects and stabilize thermal and axial-force responses in HDPE joining.
method: Model heat, forces, material flow and defects using a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian simulation.
Train two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force histories.
Combine simulation and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free welding conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: Simulations agreed with experimental responses and void formation; ANNs achieved R² of 0.91–0.99, while 60 °C preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to about 1100 N.
infographic.watch_item: Performance beyond the tested welding parameters remains unestablished; new geometries or operating ranges require validation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为连接热塑性材料的有效技术。本研究综合采用计算建模和机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行全面的预测研究，并通过实验结果加以验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，以模拟不同转速、焊接速度和底部预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。通过实验数据验证了CEL数值模型，结果表明，该模型在预测孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应方面与实验高度吻合。结果显示，底面预热能够有效减小温度梯度，并抑制垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从未预热时的70 °C升至约100 °C，从而减缓厚度方向的温度梯度，并使轴向力分布更加稳定。同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力随时间变化的响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明模型在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高精度和较强泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架能够快速生成工艺图，明确有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在所测试条件下，最优工艺条件为1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C预热；在1000 rpm且未预热的条件下，因形成隧道型缺陷而表现出较差的可焊性。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了计算建模与机器学习的融合如何实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW工艺的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合三维焊接模拟与神经网络，确定了所测试条件下HDPE搅拌摩擦焊的最优工艺条件：1500 rpm、30 mm/min及60 °C底部预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架支持焊接工艺窗口的选择，有助于减少HDPE连接中的焊接缺陷，并稳定热响应和轴向力响应。
method: 采用三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模拟，对热、力、材料流动和缺陷进行建模。
利用实验测得的温度和轴向力时间历程训练两个多层感知机神经网络。
结合模拟与ANN预测，绘制有缺陷和无缺陷焊接条件的工艺图。
infographic.evidence_signal: 模拟结果与实验响应及孔洞形成情况吻合；ANN的R²达到0.91–0.99，而60 °C预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 在所测试焊接参数范围之外的性能尚未确定；新的几何构型或操作范围需要验证。

title: Microstructure and surface performance of detonation gun sprayed 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY coatings on Al 6061-T6 substrate for structural applications
authors: T. Sampath kumar, Rajaram Ganesan, M.M. Reddy
abstract: Two protective coatings, 80Ni20Cr and NiCrAlY, were deposited on Al 6061-T6 alloy substrates using the Detonation Gun (D-Gun) thermal spray process. The deposited coatings were studied for their microstructure, phase composition, surface roughness, hardness, corrosion behaviour, wettability, and solid particle erosion resistance. Characterisation was done using SEM-EDS, XRD, AFM, nanoindentation, potentiodynamic polarisation, contact angle measurement, and erosion testing. SEM-EDS results showed that both coatings bonded well to the substrate with uniform thickness. The NiCrAlY coating had a denser microstructure with lower porosity compared to 80Ni20Cr. XRD identified CrNi phases with FCC crystal structure in 80Ni20Cr and Al₂NiY phases with orthorhombic structure in NiCrAlY. Nanocrystalline grain structure was observed in both coatings. AFM measurements showed that NiCrAlY had the lowest surface roughness among all three samples. Nanoindentation results showed that NiCrAlY hardness is approximately 10 times higher than 80Ni20Cr. Specifically, NiCrAlY showed a hardness of 7895.36 MPa (731.2 HV), compared with 780.11 MPa (72.25 HV) for 80Ni20Cr and 708.68 MPa for the uncoated Al 6061 substrate. Potentiodynamic polarisation tests in 3.5 wt% NaCl solution confirmed that NiCrAlY recorded the lowest corrosion current density of 6.625 × 10 -7 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.00567 mmpy. The 80Ni20Cr coating gave a corrosion current density of 1.585 × 10 - 6 A/cm² and a corrosion rate of 0.01427 mmpy. Both figures are considerably lower than the bare substrate at 0.5185 mmpy. Contact angle measurements confirmed superhydrophobic behaviour for NiCrAlY and near-superhydrophobic behaviour for 80Ni20Cr. Solid particle erosion test results showed that 80Ni20Cr recorded the lowest mass loss. Under the laboratory conditions used (3.5 wt% NaCl at room temperature; a single erosion condition of 90° impact angle, 40 m/s and 5 min), NiCrAlY showed the better hardness and corrosion resistance, whereas 80Ni20Cr showed the better erosion resistance. These results indicate relative performance under the test conditions and are not a prediction of long-term service life.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Coating selection should match the dominant damage mechanism: NiCrAlY for hardness and chloride-corrosion protection, or 80Ni20Cr for the tested erosion exposure.

zh-Hans.title: 面向结构应用的Al 6061-T6基体上爆炸喷涂80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织与表面性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂（D-Gun）热喷涂工艺，在Al 6061-T6合金基体上沉积了80Ni20Cr和NiCrAlY两种防护涂层。研究了所沉积涂层的微观组织、物相组成、表面粗糙度、硬度、腐蚀行为、润湿性及抗固体颗粒冲蚀性能。采用SEM-EDS、XRD、AFM、纳米压痕、动电位极化、接触角测量及冲蚀试验进行表征。SEM-EDS结果表明，两种涂层均与基体结合良好，且厚度均匀。与80Ni20Cr相比，NiCrAlY涂层的微观组织更致密，孔隙率更低。XRD在80Ni20Cr中鉴定出具有面心立方（FCC）晶体结构的CrNi相，在NiCrAlY中鉴定出具有正交晶体结构的Al₂NiY相。两种涂层中均观察到纳米晶组织。AFM测量表明，NiCrAlY在全部三个样品中具有最低的表面粗糙度。纳米压痕结果表明，NiCrAlY的硬度约为80Ni20Cr的10倍。具体而言，NiCrAlY的硬度为7895.36 MPa（731.2 HV），80Ni20Cr为780.11 MPa（72.25 HV），未涂覆的Al 6061基体为708.68 MPa。在3.5 wt% NaCl溶液中进行的动电位极化试验证实，NiCrAlY的腐蚀电流密度最低，为6.625 × 10⁻⁷ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.00567 mmpy。80Ni20Cr涂层的腐蚀电流密度为1.585 × 10⁻⁶ A/cm²，腐蚀速率为0.01427 mmpy。两种涂层的腐蚀速率均显著低于裸基体的0.5185 mmpy。接触角测量证实，NiCrAlY表现出超疏水性，80Ni20Cr表现出接近超疏水的特性。固体颗粒冲蚀试验结果表明，80Ni20Cr的质量损失最低。在所采用的实验室条件下（室温下的3.5 wt% NaCl溶液；冲击角度90°、速度40 m/s、持续时间5 min的单一冲蚀工况），NiCrAlY表现出更高的硬度和更好的耐腐蚀性，而80Ni20Cr表现出更好的抗冲蚀性能。这些结果反映了试验条件下的相对性能，并非对长期服役寿命的预测。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr combined the lowest measured wear rate with the best corrosion resistance, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: HVAF is a promising coating route for 304 stainless steel components requiring both wear and corrosion protection.

zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层，并系统研究和比较了这些涂层的微观组织、摩擦学性能和耐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更佳。耐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 VSCE)、最低的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层的耐蚀性在这四种涂层中最差。

title: Microstructure and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of HVOF and plasma sprayed Ni–Cr-based ceramic coatings on SA516 boiler steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr-based coatings could improve oxidation protection of SA516 boiler components exposed to high temperatures.

infographic.evidence_signal: Laboratory testing linked improved oxidation resistance to reduced porosity, enhanced microhardness, and protective oxides including Cr2O3, TiO2, NiTiO4, and NiO; bare steel showed severe scale cracking and spalling.

title: Integration of DMAIC and Two-Level Fuzzy AHP for Diagnosing and Prioritizing Waste and Potential Causes of Welding Defects in a Sidebeam Bogie Frame
authors: I Putu Dhanu Artha, Anak Agung Istri Agung Sri Komaladewi, I Gusti Ngurah Priambadi
abstract: Welding defects remain a critical quality issue in the robotic minor assembly welding process of the TB1014 Sidebeam Bogie Frame, affecting production efficiency and product quality. This study aims to evaluate baseline process performance, identify and prioritize manufacturing waste and its underlying causes, and propose a structured improvement roadmap. A Lean Six Sigma framework using the Define–Measure–Analyze–Improve–Control (DMAIC) approach was integrated with a two-level Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (Fuzzy AHP). Process performance was evaluated using Value Stream Mapping (VSM), time study, a u′-control chart, Defects Per Million Opportunities (DPMO), and sigma level analysis. We then applied Fuzzy AHP to expert judgments from ten respondents to prioritize four waste categories, followed by a 6M fishbone analysis and a second Fuzzy AHP assessment of potential cause categories. The results identified 485 welding defects across 21 inspected units, corresponding to a DPMO of 136,658.21 and a sigma level of 2.60. Undercut accounted for 57.1% of defects, while Process Cycle Efficiency (PCE) was only 4.88%. Defects emerged as the dominant waste category (0.7174), while Machine (0.4803), Method (0.2890), and Man (0.1596) were the leading potential cause categories. However, weak expert agreement and sensitivity to respondent selection indicate uncertainty in the prioritization results. Based on these findings and corrective-action records, an improvement roadmap is proposed focusing on seam-tracking verification, robot parameter standardization, jig and fixture positioning, tack welding, and fit-up control. The proposed improvements require implementation and empirical validation to establish their effectiveness.

zh-Hans.abstract: 在TB1014侧梁转向架构架的机器人小部件组焊工序中，焊接缺陷仍是影响生产效率和产品质量的关键质量问题。本研究旨在评估工序的基线绩效，识别制造浪费及其根本原因并确定优先级，同时提出结构化的改进路线图。研究将采用定义—测量—分析—改进—控制（DMAIC）方法的精益六西格玛框架与两级模糊层次分析法（Fuzzy AHP）相结合。通过价值流图（VSM）、时间研究、u′控制图、百万机会缺陷数（DPMO）和西格玛水平分析评估工序绩效。随后，基于十名受访专家的判断，应用Fuzzy AHP确定四类浪费的优先级，再通过6M鱼骨图分析及第二级Fuzzy AHP评估确定潜在原因类别的优先级。结果显示，在21件受检产品中共发现485处焊接缺陷，对应的DPMO为136,658.21，西格玛水平为2.60。咬边占缺陷总数的57.1%，而流程周期效率（PCE）仅为4.88%。缺陷是最主要的浪费类别（0.7174），设备（0.4803）、方法（0.2890）和人员（0.1596）则是最主要的潜在原因类别。然而，专家意见一致性较弱，且结果对受访者选择敏感，表明优先级排序存在不确定性。基于这些发现及纠正措施记录，本研究提出了改进路线图，重点包括焊缝跟踪验证、机器人参数标准化、工装夹具定位、定位焊和组对控制。所提出的改进措施仍需实施并通过实证验证，以确定其有效性。

infographic.key_insight: 通过集成DMAIC与两级Fuzzy AHP，研究确定缺陷是最主要的浪费，并对侧梁转向架构架焊接缺陷背后的设备、方法和操作人员因素进行了优先级排序。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power, welding speed, and current govern molten-pool flow, weld geometry, and arc stability.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter–response relationships can guide welding-process optimization for low-expansion Invar tooling used in aerospace composite manufacturing.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics
High-speed photography of welding behavior
Comparison across laser power, welding speed, and current
infographic.evidence_signal: Across 5–6 kW, higher laser power increased penetration and keyhole size; across 0.5–0.8 m/min, higher speed reduced penetration and weld width; across 150–170 A, higher current widened the weld and stabilized the arc.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract reports trends within limited parameter ranges but provides no quantitative simulation–experiment agreement or weld-property validation.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢的热膨胀系数极低，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变和电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大会提高反冲压力，从而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，增强熔池整体流动，且在高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，速度提高会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，高速下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度增大并强化熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光–TIG复合焊接中，激光功率、焊接速度和电流决定熔池流动、焊缝几何形状及电弧稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些参数–响应关系可为航空航天复合材料制造所用低膨胀Invar钢工装的焊接工艺优化提供指导。

title: Evaluation of Induction Thermography for the Detection of Cracks Due to Mechanical and Thermal Stress in WC-10Co-4Cr Coatings
authors: Niklas Steinbrecher, A. Meier, Hans Jürgen Maier, Manuel Rodriguez Diaz, Kai Möhwald, Sebastian Barton
abstract: Abstract WC–Co-Cr coatings have exceptional mechanical properties including high hardness, wear resistance and corrosion resistance. However, under continuous wear or mechanical/thermal overloads, such as line loads in calender rollers or improper heating/cooling cycles, these coatings can develop defects like cracks and dents. Such damage compromises product quality, particularly in calendering processes where precise roller concentricity (single-figure micrometre range) is critical. This study investigates induction thermography as a non-destructive alternative for defect detection in WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Coated C60 steel specimens with different surface roughness (conditions: ground and as-sprayed) were subjected to controlled mechanical (strains: 0.12% to 0.4%) and thermal stresses (thermal shock), inducing cracks with widths ranging from approx. 1 to 4.5 µm and depths up to the full coating thickness (≈ 400 µm). Both crack width and depth influenced the thermal contrast, with deeper cracks producing a stronger signal. Using the Fourier transform method and principal component analysis, induction thermography successfully identified cracks down to a minimum resolved width of ≈ 1 µm in ground and ≈ 1.7 µm in as-sprayed specimens, demonstrating its sensitivity to defect detection across different surface conditions. The results highlight the potential of this method to improve process reliability and product quality in high-precision applications by enabling non-invasive inspection.

infographic.key_insight: Induction thermography detected micrometre-scale cracks in WC-10Co-4Cr coatings, with minimum resolved widths of approximately 1 µm on ground surfaces and 1.7 µm on as-sprayed surfaces.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Non-destructive crack inspection could improve maintenance and product quality in coated calender rollers, where micrometre-scale dimensional precision is critical.
method: Tested WC-10Co-4Cr-coated C60 steel with ground and as-sprayed surfaces.
Induced cracks using mechanical strains of 0.12–0.4% and thermal shock.
Evaluated induction thermography signals using Fourier analysis and principal component analysis.
infographic.evidence_signal: Tests covered crack widths of approximately 1–4.5 µm and depths up to the full coating thickness of approximately 400 µm; both dimensions influenced thermal contrast, with deeper cracks producing stronger signals.
infographic.watch_item: Detection sensitivity depends on surface condition and crack geometry, so the reported minimum resolved widths should not be treated as universal inspection limits.

zh-Hans.title: 感应热成像用于检测WC-10Co-4Cr涂层中机械应力和热应力所致裂纹的评估
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 WC–Co-Cr涂层具有优异的机械性能，包括高硬度、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。然而，在持续磨损或机械/热过载条件下，例如压延辊承受线载荷或经历不当的加热/冷却循环时，这些涂层可能出现裂纹和凹痕等缺陷。此类损伤会影响产品质量，尤其是在对辊筒同心度精度要求极高（个位数微米范围）的压延工艺中。本研究探讨将感应热成像作为一种无损检测方法，用于检测WC-10Co-4Cr涂层中的缺陷。对具有不同表面粗糙度（表面状态：磨削态和喷涂原始态）的涂层C60钢试样施加受控机械应力（应变：0.12%至0.4%）和热应力（热冲击），诱发宽度约为1至4.5 µm、深度最大贯穿整个涂层厚度（≈ 400 µm）的裂纹。裂纹宽度和深度均影响热对比度，其中较深的裂纹产生更强的信号。结合傅里叶变换法和主成分分析，感应热成像成功识别出磨削态试样中最小可分辨宽度为≈ 1 µm、喷涂原始态试样中最小可分辨宽度为≈ 1.7 µm的裂纹，展现了其在不同表面状态下检测缺陷的灵敏度。结果表明，该方法可通过非侵入式检测，在高精度应用中提升工艺可靠性和产品质量，具有应用潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 感应热成像检测出了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层中的微米级裂纹，磨削表面上的最小可分辨宽度约为1 µm，喷涂原始表面上约为1.7 µm。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 无损裂纹检测有望改善涂层压延辊的维护和产品质量；在此类应用中，微米级尺寸精度至关重要。
method: 对具有磨削表面和喷涂原始表面的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层C60钢进行测试。
利用0.12–0.4%的机械应变和热冲击诱发裂纹。
采用傅里叶分析和主成分分析评估感应热成像信号。
infographic.evidence_signal: 测试涵盖宽度约为1–4.5 µm、深度最大贯穿约400 µm涂层全厚度的裂纹；宽度和深度均影响热对比度，较深的裂纹产生更强的信号。
infographic.watch_item: 检测灵敏度取决于表面状态和裂纹几何形态，因此不应将所报告的最小可分辨宽度视为普遍适用的检测极限。

title: EFFECT OF CEO2 AND LA2O3 REINFORCEMENTS ON MECHANICAL, TRIBOLOGICAL AND MICROSTRUCTURAL PROPERTIES OF WC–12CO COATING BY HIGH-VELOCITY OXYGEN FUEL DEPOSITION TECHNIQUE
authors: Satyanarayan Dubey, Shyam Birla, Tribhuwan Kishore Mishra
abstract: Decarburization during HVOF deposition reduces the workability of Tungsten Carbide-12% Cobalt (WC-12Co) coatings. This work examines how CeO2 and La2O3 reinforcements affect HVOF-sprayed WC-12Co coatings' mechanical, tribological, and microstructural characteristics. Compared to the unreinforced coating, microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, abrasive wear, coefficient of friction, and microhardness were assessed. CeO2 or La2O3 decreased porosity and finer grain structure without affecting bond strength. Coatings with 1 wt.% CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively, compared to the unreinforced WC-12Co coating, which had an adhesive bond strength of 73.60 ± 5 MPa. Both changed coatings improved structural stability, grain refinement, and densification. Minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m was found in WC-12Co-1La2O3, whereas the lowest coefficient of friction was 0.4 in WC-12Co-1CeO2. An oxide layer from reinforcements enhanced wear resistance. SEM investigation of worn surfaces showed debris, dislodged carbide particles, SiC grains, microcracks, and grooves as the predominant wear processes.

infographic.key_insight: Adding 1 wt.% CeO2 or La2O3 to HVOF-sprayed WC–12Co refined the microstructure, reduced porosity, and improved hardness and wear performance without affecting bond strength.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Rare-earth oxide reinforcement offers a route to denser, wear-resistant WC–12Co coatings for components exposed to friction and abrasion.
method: Deposit unreinforced and CeO2- or La2O3-reinforced WC–12Co coatings using HVOF.
Compare microstructure, phase composition, bond strength, microhardness, abrasive wear, and friction.
Examine worn surfaces using SEM to identify wear mechanisms.
infographic.evidence_signal: At 1 wt.% reinforcement, CeO2 and La2O3 increased microhardness by 6% and 4%, respectively; La2O3 achieved the minimum wear rate of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), while CeO2 achieved the lowest friction coefficient of 0.4.

zh-Hans.title: CeO2和La2O3增强相对超音速火焰喷涂WC–12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: HVOF沉积过程中的脱碳会降低碳化钨-12%钴（WC-12Co）涂层的加工性能。本研究考察了CeO2和La2O3增强相对HVOF喷涂WC-12Co涂层力学性能、摩擦学性能及微观组织特征的影响。以未增强涂层为对照，评估了微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、磨粒磨损、摩擦系数和显微硬度。CeO2或La2O3的加入降低了孔隙率并细化了晶粒，且未影响结合强度。与未增强的WC-12Co涂层相比，分别添加1 wt.% CeO2和La2O3的涂层显微硬度分别提高了6%和4%；未增强涂层的黏附结合强度为73.60 ± 5 MPa。两种改性涂层均表现出更好的结构稳定性、晶粒细化和致密化效果。WC-12Co-1La2O3的磨损率最低，为3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/N·m，而WC-12Co-1CeO2的摩擦系数最低，为0.4。增强相形成的氧化层提高了耐磨性。对磨损表面的SEM观察显示，主要磨损过程表现为磨屑、脱落的碳化物颗粒、SiC晶粒、微裂纹和犁沟。

infographic.key_insight: 向HVOF喷涂WC–12Co涂层中添加1 wt.% CeO2或La2O3，可细化微观组织、降低孔隙率，并提高硬度和耐磨性能，且不影响结合强度。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 稀土氧化物增强为制备用于承受摩擦和磨粒磨损部件的更致密、耐磨的WC–12Co涂层提供了一条途径。
method: 采用HVOF沉积未增强以及CeO2或La2O3增强的WC–12Co涂层。
比较微观组织、物相组成、结合强度、显微硬度、磨粒磨损和摩擦性能。
采用SEM观察磨损表面，以识别磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在增强相添加量为1 wt.%时，CeO2和La2O3分别使显微硬度提高了6%和4%；La2O3增强涂层的磨损率最低，为3.5 × 10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，而CeO2增强涂层的摩擦系数最低，为0.4。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明磨损试验条件或长期耐久性，这限制了将这些结果直接应用于服役环境。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating performance depends on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF provides a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Matching feedstock and spray process to service demands can improve the wear resistance and durability of machine parts under intensive friction and high loads.
method: Compare detonation-sprayed and HVOF WC–Co–Cr coatings.
Examine powder morphology and coating microstructure using SEM and EDS.
Evaluate coating microhardness and tribological behavior.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports average microhardness of 1449 HV for detonation-sprayed coatings and a friction coefficient of Kt = 0.143 for HVOF coatings.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify test conditions, variability, or comparative wear rates, limiting assessment of performance under specific service conditions.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF与爆炸喷涂制备WC–Co–Cr涂层的组织形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究分析了原始粉末的形貌，并采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散能谱（EDS）分析了涂层的微观组织和相组成。结果表明，使用均质、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相均匀分布于金属基体中。爆炸喷涂可制备出硬度更高的涂层（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF可制备出致密度高、微观组织均匀且摩擦系数低（Kt = 0.143）的涂层。对比分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法。这些发现有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，对强烈摩擦和高载荷条件下的运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr涂层的性能取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法：爆炸喷涂有利于提高硬度，而HVOF可获得致密、均匀且摩擦系数低的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 使喷涂原料和喷涂工艺与服役需求相匹配，可提高机械零件在强烈摩擦和高载荷条件下的耐磨性和耐久性。
method: 对比爆炸喷涂和HVOF制备的WC–Co–Cr涂层。
采用SEM和EDS研究粉末形貌及涂层微观组织。
评估涂层的显微硬度和摩擦学行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，爆炸喷涂涂层的平均显微硬度为1449 HV，HVOF涂层的摩擦系数为Kt = 0.143。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明试验条件、变异性或对比磨损率，因此对特定服役条件下性能的评估受到限制。

title: Interpretable ensemble learning for tensile strength prediction and welding process window optimization of friction stir-welded 7N01 aluminum alloy
authors: Xiaocui Wu, Yingjie Zhao, Huijie Zhang, Qi Cheng, Limao Wei, Yuwang Liu
abstract: This study aims to achieve high-accuracy prediction of the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) of friction stir-welded A7N01P-T4 aluminum alloy joints, elucidate the effects of welding parameters on UTS, and optimize the welding process window. Rotational speed, welding speed, and shoulder plunge depth were used as input variables, with UTS as the output. Machine learning models were developed using 27 experimental samples and evaluated by leave-one-out cross-validation. Comparison of decision tree, K-nearest neighbors, and Gaussian process regression identifies decision tree as the best baseline model, with an R 2 of 0.905. An ensemble learning strategy was subsequently introduced to construct a gradient boosting decision tree, increasing R 2 to 0.966, and grid search optimization of its key hyperparameters further improves R 2 to 0.978. SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis shows that the importance of the welding parameters follows the order of welding speed, rotational speed, and shoulder plunge depth, and the identified parameter effects agree well with the experimental results and observed microstructural evolution. The optimized model predicts fully feasible ranges of all the welding parameters for a joint efficiency of at least 90%, and the shoulder plunge depth acts as a key parameter for further refining the high-strength welding process window. These results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only improves the accuracy of UTS prediction but also reveals welding parameter effects and enables optimization of the welding process window, providing a quantitative basis for selecting FSW parameters.

zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究旨在高精度预测搅拌摩擦焊A7N01P-T4铝合金接头的极限抗拉强度（UTS），阐明焊接参数对UTS的影响，并优化焊接工艺窗口。以转速、焊接速度和轴肩下压量为输入变量，以UTS为输出变量。利用27个实验样本建立机器学习模型，并采用留一交叉验证进行评估。通过比较决策树、K近邻和高斯过程回归，确定决策树为最佳基线模型，其R²为0.905。随后引入集成学习策略，构建梯度提升决策树，将R²提高至0.966；通过网格搜索优化其关键超参数，进一步将R²提高至0.978。夏普利加性解释（SHapley Additive exPlanations）分析表明，焊接参数的重要性由高到低依次为焊接速度、转速和轴肩下压量，且所识别的参数影响与实验结果及观察到的微观组织演变高度一致。优化后的模型预测了接头效率至少达到90%时所有焊接参数的完全可行取值范围，其中轴肩下压量是进一步细化高强度焊接工艺窗口的关键参数。这些结果表明，所提出的方法不仅提高了UTS预测精度，还揭示了焊接参数的影响，并实现了焊接工艺窗口优化，为搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）参数选择提供了定量依据。

title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
authors: Hariharan Venkataraman, Vishal Uttamrao Bagade, V.M. Biju
abstract: Systematic optimization of high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, requires numerous experiments to determine the conditions that maximize coating quality. In this study, full factorial design (FFD), a more robust and efficient methodology than the traditional one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) methodology, was employed to investigate the influence of HVOF spray parameters of Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coating deposited onto a Ti6Al4V substrate. The design of experiments (DOE) approach using an FFD with 24 experimental runs was employed to evaluate all input factors at two levels. The coating response properties were measured for each experimental run. Analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to quantify the contribution of each spray parameter to the output responses. The effect of the interaction between spray parameters, such as spray distance, powder feed rate, and fuel gas flow rates, on the coating properties for this substrate-coating combination has scarcely been reported. Hence, a Pareto chart was also utilized to analyze the interaction effects of the spray parameters on coating properties. Finally, acceptable quality attributes such as hardness, porosity, and oxides were established with the spraying parameters, namely, standoff distance, powder feed rate, hydrogen flow rate, and oxygen flow rate, respectively, at the values of 150 mm, 25 g/min, 475 NLPM, and 205 NLPM.

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低空间金属连接中机器人焊接的风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 随着人们对空间服务、制造与装配的兴趣日益增长，用于模块化建造和在轨维修的可靠金属连接技术再次受到关注。机器人焊接具有应用前景，但对其在低重力和低压条件下的运行特性仍缺乏充分认识，且接近实际飞行条件的试验有限。由英国航天局（UK Space Agency）支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发基于物理的数字孪生，以系统化降低工艺风险。本文评估了一种基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积熔池热模型、高斯过程（GP）与神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不进入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八个输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界工况中，80 个求解器响应中的 74 个落在 GP 的标称 90% 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括缩放处理和预测方差计算。在一项 UR5 沿 L 形焊缝焊接的仿真研究中，当行进速度在拐角附近下降时，比例控制器会调整协同焊接电源的设定值。有限体积法重新评估发现，全部 12 个闭环运行点和 12 个开环运行点中的 9 个均处于示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 背面焊缝宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接条件和控制策略。仍需开展热真空试验、有针对性的低重力试验以及机器人硬件在环研究，以评估模型和控制器。

title: Impact Of Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr binder systems on the microstructure and functional properties of WC coatings produced by detonation spraying
authors: Zarina Aringozhina, Нуртолеу Магазов, Nazerke Muktanova, Gulzhaz Uazyrkhanova
abstract: This study investigates the influence of metallic binder composition (Co–Cr, Ni, and NiCr) on the microstructure and performance characteristics of tungsten carbide-based coatings deposited by detonation spraying. A comprehensive characterization was carried out using scanning electron microscopy, EDS elemental mapping, microhardness testing, tribological evaluation, scratch testing, and electrochemical corrosion analysis. The results demonstrate that binder type significantly affects coating porosity, WC phase distribution, hardness, and tribological behavior. The WC–Co-Cr coating exhibited the most favorable combination of properties: the lowest coefficient of friction (0.515), the highest microhardness (1232.55 HV), the best scratch resistance, and superior corrosion resistance in 3.5 wt.% NaCl solution. The WC–Ni coating showed the lowest porosity (0.40%) due to the high fluidity of the nickel binder, while WC–NiCr demonstrated the highest porosity (2.78%) and the most pronounced susceptibility to cracking under progressive loading. The findings confirm the strong potential of detonation-sprayed WC–Co-Cr coatings for extending the service life of pipeline valves and other components operating under wear and corrosion conditions in the oil and gas industry.

zh-Hans.title: Co–Cr、Ni 和 NiCr 黏结相体系对爆炸喷涂制备的 WC 涂层微观组织与功能性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了金属黏结相成分（Co–Cr、Ni 和 NiCr）对爆炸喷涂沉积的碳化钨基涂层微观组织与性能特征的影响。采用扫描电子显微镜、EDS 元素面分布分析、显微硬度测试、摩擦学评价、划痕测试和电化学腐蚀分析进行了综合表征。结果表明，黏结相类型显著影响涂层孔隙率、WC 相分布、硬度和摩擦学行为。WC–Co-Cr 涂层表现出最优的综合性能：最低的摩擦系数（0.515）、最高的显微硬度（1232.55 HV）、最佳的抗划痕性能，以及在 3.5 wt.% NaCl 溶液中优异的耐腐蚀性能。由于镍黏结相具有较高的流动性，WC–Ni 涂层的孔隙率最低（0.40%）；而 WC–NiCr 的孔隙率最高（2.78%），且在渐增载荷下表现出最明显的开裂倾向。研究结果证实，爆炸喷涂 WC–Co-Cr 涂层在延长石油天然气行业中处于磨损和腐蚀工况下的管道阀门及其他部件的使用寿命方面具有巨大潜力。

title: Indentation Evaluation of Elastic–Plastic Response and Surface Modifications in Stainless Steel
authors: Канжигит Г.А., Ф. Р. Капсаламова, Aiym Nabioldina, Renat E. Beissenov, Mariya M. Gurariy, Alex A. Volinsky
abstract: This study applies a depth-based description of indentation response to AISI 321 stainless steel and a detonation-sprayed FeNiCoMoW coating. Martens hardness HM was evaluated from the maximum indentation depth, while a residual-depth-based quantity Hpl was calculated using the retained depth. The corresponding hardness ratio Hpl/HM was examined in relation to the retained-depth fraction. Instrumented Vickers indentation was performed on untreated AISI 321 stainless steel and the FeNiCoMoW coating. Maximum and residual indentation depths were obtained from load–displacement curves. Coating morphology was examined by optical microscopy and phase composition by X-ray diffraction. The FeNiCoMoW coating formed a continuous layer with a 145 ± 8 μm thickness. Compared with the substrate, the coating reduced the retained-depth fraction from 0.906 to 0.788 and increased the hardness ratio from 1.22 to 1.61. Indentation hardness increased from 2.3 ± 0.17 GPa for the substrate to 8.65 ± 1 GPa for the coating. X-ray diffraction identified the (Mo,W)₂C carbide crystalline phase together with an fcc (Co,Ni,Fe) solid solution and σ- and μ-type intermetallic compounds. The proposed descriptors provide a compact characterization of indentation response and distinguish retained-depth behavior from conventional contact-depth-based hardness measurements. For the investigated coating, the lower retained-depth fraction and higher hardness indicate a greater recovered-depth contribution during unloading.

infographic.key_insight: The detonation-sprayed FeNiCoMoW coating increased indentation hardness and reduced the retained-depth fraction relative to AISI 321 stainless steel, indicating greater depth recovery during unloading.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The coating offers a harder surface, while depth-based indentation descriptors help distinguish retained deformation from unloading recovery.
method: Instrumented Vickers indentation of untreated AISI 321 steel and the FeNiCoMoW coating.
Calculate Martens hardness, residual-depth-based hardness, and retained-depth fraction from load–displacement curves.
Assess coating morphology by optical microscopy and phase composition by X-ray diffraction.
infographic.evidence_signal: The continuous coating was 145 ± 8 µm thick; indentation hardness increased from 2.3 ± 0.17 to 8.65 ± 1 GPa, retained-depth fraction decreased from 0.906 to 0.788, and Hpl/HM increased from 1.22 to 1.61.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not report adhesion, wear, or service-life testing, so higher indentation hardness alone does not establish component durability.
infographic.paper_title: Indentation Evaluation of Elastic–Plastic Response and Surface Modifications in Stainless Steel

zh-Hans.title: 不锈钢弹塑性响应与表面改性的压痕评价
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究将基于深度的压痕响应描述方法应用于 AISI 321 不锈钢和爆炸喷涂 FeNiCoMoW 涂层。根据最大压痕深度评估马氏硬度 HM，并利用残余深度计算基于残余深度的量 Hpl。考察了相应硬度比 Hpl/HM 与残余深度占比之间的关系。对未经处理的 AISI 321 不锈钢和 FeNiCoMoW 涂层进行了仪器化维氏压痕试验。从载荷–位移曲线中获得最大压痕深度和残余压痕深度。采用光学显微镜观察涂层形貌，并通过 X 射线衍射分析物相组成。FeNiCoMoW 涂层形成了厚度为 145 ± 8 μm 的连续层。与基体相比，涂层使残余深度占比从 0.906 降至 0.788，并使硬度比从 1.22 增至 1.61。压痕硬度从基体的 2.3 ± 0.17 GPa 增至涂层的 8.65 ± 1 GPa。X 射线衍射鉴定出 (Mo,W)₂C 碳化物晶相、面心立方（fcc）(Co,Ni,Fe) 固溶体以及 σ 型和 μ 型金属间化合物。所提出的描述参数能够简洁地表征压痕响应，并将残余深度行为与传统的基于接触深度的硬度测量区分开来。对于所研究的涂层，较低的残余深度占比和较高的硬度表明，卸载过程中深度恢复的贡献更大。

infographic.key_insight: 相较于 AISI 321 不锈钢，爆炸喷涂 FeNiCoMoW 涂层提高了压痕硬度并降低了残余深度占比，表明卸载过程中深度恢复更大。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该涂层可提供更硬的表面，而基于深度的压痕描述参数有助于区分残余变形与卸载恢复。
method: 对未经处理的 AISI 321 钢和 FeNiCoMoW 涂层进行仪器化维氏压痕试验。
根据载荷–位移曲线计算马氏硬度、基于残余深度的硬度以及残余深度占比。
采用光学显微镜评估涂层形貌，并通过 X 射线衍射分析物相组成。
infographic.evidence_signal: 连续涂层的厚度为 145 ± 8 µm；压痕硬度从 2.3 ± 0.17 增至 8.65 ± 1 GPa，残余深度占比从 0.906 降至 0.788，Hpl/HM 从 1.22 增至 1.61。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未报告附着力、磨损或使用寿命测试，因此仅凭较高的压痕硬度尚不能确定部件的耐久性。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, low-porosity Fe-based amorphous coatings improve long-term corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity reduces friction and wear.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Detonation-spray parameter control can help produce protective coatings for carbon-steel components exposed to corrosion and humidity-dependent wear.
method: Deposit Fe-based amorphous coatings on Q235 carbon steel using varied detonation-spray parameters.
Examine droplet morphology, lamellar structure, and coating porosity.
Evaluate long-term corrosion and sliding wear under different humidity conditions using Si3N4 balls.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract associates greater porosity with poorer long-term corrosion resistance and reports decreasing friction coefficient and wear rate as humidity increases.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical performance gains or humidity ranges, and wear trends may depend on the Si3N4 counterface chemistry.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为及其在不同湿度环境下的磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用爆炸喷涂技术，在不同喷涂参数下于Q235碳钢表面成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀与摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷、形成具有致密微观组织的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷越多，其长期耐腐蚀性越低。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层在不同湿度条件下的磨损行为具有重要作用。随着湿度升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率均降低。

infographic.key_insight: 致密、低孔隙率的铁基非晶涂层可提高长期耐腐蚀性，而湿度升高可降低摩擦和磨损。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 控制爆炸喷涂参数有助于为承受腐蚀及湿度相关磨损的碳钢部件制备防护涂层。
method: 采用不同的爆炸喷涂参数，在Q235碳钢表面沉积铁基非晶涂层。
表征液滴形貌、层片结构及涂层孔隙率。
评估长期腐蚀行为，并使用Si3N4球评估不同湿度条件下的滑动磨损行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要指出，孔隙率越高，长期耐腐蚀性越差，并报告了摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低的趋势。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供性能提升的具体数值或湿度范围，且磨损趋势可能取决于Si3N4对偶面的化学性质。
